questions.q: Why is it important for a graphic designer or artist to use the Principles of Design?
options: To ensure they spend exactly the right amount of money on paints.
To efficiently organize visual elements so the artwork successfully communicates its intended message and looks aesthetically pleasing.
Because otherwise, the paint will not stick to the canvas.
questions.explain: The principles of design are primarily used to arrange visual elements effectively, making the composition appealing to the eye and ensuring the viewer understands the intended message or emotional tone.

questions.q: An interior decorator sets a large sofa against a wall and places a heavy bookshelf against the opposite wall to ensure the room feels comfortable and evenly weighted. Which principle is being applied?
questions.explain: The decorator is equalizing the visual and physical weight in the space. Distributing 'heavy' elements evenly so the room doesn't feel tilted or unanchored is a classic use of the Balance principle.
